column1: # check<TAB>record<TAB>reason. Deliberate, documented asymmetries for
# tools/check-checkout-parity.ts: an outcome record that is INTENDED to differ
# between a primary repository, a lane worktree and land-main.
# `check` is a declared member id from DECLARED_CHECKS. `record` is the outcome
# key exactly as the finding prints it inside record="..." -- for the ledger
# member that is `<file> [<check>]`, e.g. `instance/decisions/inbox.jsonl [ledger]`.
# Both directions are errors, the same way instance/expected-mechanism-exclusions.tsv
# treats its own: a STALE exemption (the record no longer diverges) and an ORPHAN
# exemption (no declared check by that id) both fail. An exemption is a claim
# about current state and is re-verified on every run.
# An exemption whose check this run could not compare in two worlds is reported
# UNVERIFIED and makes the run UNKNOWN. It is not called stale: a run that did
# not measure the check did not measure whether the exemption is still needed,
# and saying otherwise would be a statement about evidence that does not exist.
# EMPTY ON PURPOSE as of 2026-08-07, and the empty state is the finding.
# The live divergence on this host is the consilium's own: `instance/decisions/
# inbox.jsonl` is deliberately untracked (instructions/repository-hygiene.md), so
# the ledger aging check RUNS in the primary repository and SKIPs in a lane
# worktree and in land-main -- the two places the landing gate actually runs it.
# It is tempting to write that row here, because the file's untrackedness IS
# deliberate. That would be the wrong reading of the word. What is deliberate is
# where the file lives; what is NOT deliberate is that the check measuring the
# ledger silently does not happen where landings are decided. That second thing
# is the defect the consilium found, and an exemption for it would restore
# exactly the blindness this checker was rejected once for having.
# So this file stays empty, tools/check-checkout-parity.ts reports FAIL on this
# host, and that FAIL is a true statement about a live, open defect rather than a
# green nobody should have believed. Closing it means making the ledger check
# measure the same thing in all three checkout kinds -- not writing a row here.
